== Summary ==
[[Jonathan Quesenberry]], Decipher's Red Leader, on Decipher's Star Wars CCG "Rebel Leaders" page (March 1997). The page's image alt text reads "Jonathan Quesenberry's photo". Photo: Decipher. 144 × 136 px, the only size Decipher published.

== Source ==
* [http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/index.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Rebel Leaders], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327211720/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/index.html Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970328005919im_/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/images/jonathan.gif jonathan.gif] (Wayback 28 March 1997; this file is that capture, SHA-256 831f130413ae6a915e17f86304867172b2d145227f8fb41f6aeb544f12a6aeb9).

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Jonathan Quesenberry]] and his row on [[Anagrams]] (the card [[Bren Quersey]]).
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution Decipher published.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of him is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use.
* '''Copyright:''' Decipher Inc. Used under fair use for identification only.
